topics.caution: Introducing કુતમ્મા as a 'ગરીબ વિધવા' risks the explanation adding pity or stigma to widowhood, or building her up into an exceptional heroine beyond what the paragraph actually says.
topics.guidance: Keep the explanation to what the chunk states — a mother who did hard physical labour and valued her son's ભણતર — without a widow-pity note and without generalising about widows.

topics.caution: 'જેમ ખોરડું વધારે ગરીબ, એમ એ ભાવના વધારે મજબૂત' could be over-explained into a general claim that poverty itself produces truer hospitality, romanticising poverty as a life lesson.
topics.guidance: Keep explanation on the specific practice the paragraph names — welcoming a stranger with no expectation of return — not on a rule linking wealth level to virtue; the real_life_example should anchor to an ordinary act of hosting a guest, not a rich-vs-poor comparison.

topics.caution: The family-planning line ('મેં ને મારા વરે... કુટુંબનિયોજન અપનાવેલું... વસ્તાર ભેગો કરીએ તો એકેયમાં ભલીવાર નોં આવે') could be expanded by the explanation into a general lesson on ideal family size.
topics.guidance: Keep it as કુતમ્માની પોતાની યાદ — a choice she and her husband made for their son's ભણતર, in her own voice — never turned into a rule the explanation prescribes to the class.

topics.caution: The explanation could romanticise a roughly twelve-year-old going to Mumbai to wash dishes in a hotel, presenting child labour itself as the admirable path rather than as the hardship of that era.
topics.guidance: Keep the focus on ઐયપ્પાની ધીરજ and his choice to keep studying at night (રાત્રિશાળા, રાતની કોલેજ) alongside the work — that persistence is what real_life_example and explanation should praise, not the working-at-twelve itself as something a child today should copy.

topics.caution: The શ્લોક 'જનની જન્મભૂમિશ્ચ, સ્વર્ગાદપિ ગરિયસી' could be turned by the explanation into a statement about what સ્વર્ગ (heaven) actually is, rather than staying a saying about love for one's own place.
topics.guidance: Explain the શ્લોકનો ભાવ — વતન સ્વર્ગ કરતાં પણ વહાલું — as the grandfather's own saying quoted by the narrator, without unpacking સ્વર્ગ as religious doctrine; keep real_life_example inside the child's own ગામ/મહોલ્લો, never a theological point.

topics.caution: 'ભણેલી કે ગણેલી... સ્ત્રી જે કુટુંબમાં હોય, તે આખા ગામને દિપાવે' could be broadened by the explanation into a claim about what a woman's worth or duty is, rather than the chapter's own point about the value of a woman's ભણતર.
topics.guidance: Keep the explanation tied to what the line actually says — an educated woman lifts the whole village — without generalising about women's role or obligation to family.

chapter_level.guidance: કુતમ્માની બોલી is rendered in Saurashtra-flavoured તળપદું (મે'નત, વરહ, એરુ, ચિંત્યા, બૌંવ) though she is a character from Karnataka's Kanara coast in a chapter translated from English. Teach these words as the Gujarati translator's stylistic choice for rendering rural speech in this અનૂદિત સંસ્મરણ, never implying કુતમ્મા herself speaks Saurashtra Gujarati or that this is authentic Kanara-region speech.
